species: Database search was performed using MaxQuant (Ver. 2.0.3.0) using UniProt database for bovine proteins (downloaded 2022-09).
tissue: BSM (Mucin, Bovine Submaxillary Gland, Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, LOT 3776068, and LOT 3829388) was dissolved in Dulbecco’s phosphate-buffered saline (DPBS)
sample_source: This study presents a comprehensive characterization of the viscoelastic and structural properties of bovine submaxillary mucin (BSM), which is widely used as a commercial source to conduct mucus-related research.
